candidates.name: CIH (Independence, KY branch; Schricker brand)
candidates.partition_evidence: Schricker page lists toilet partitions in several materials and says CIH will 'ship and install anywhere in the USA', with installation available for every product it sells.
red_flags: Sells and supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
Independence KY is about 75 miles from Lexington; no Lexington-specific service area stated, only a nationwide ship-and-install claim
Main office is Indianapolis; KY branch phone is a 513 number
candidates.reason: Supplies and installs toilet partitions from several major brands, has a Kentucky branch, and says it installs anywhere in the USA. It is also a partition distributor, so the buy-around risk is high.

license.name: CIH (Independence, KY branch; Schricker brand)
license.registry: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government (LFUCG) contractor registration, Accela Citizen Access 'Search for Licensee' (Division of Building Inspection)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Business-name searches for 'CIH', 'CIH INC', 'C.I.H', 'C I H' and 'Schricker' all returned 'Your search returned no results.' The search appears to match on how a name begins, so CIH may be registered under a legal name we don't know. Kentucky has no state license for general or partition installation work (state licenses cover electrical, plumbing and HVAC only). LFUCG requires all contractors to register with Building Inspection (occupational license plus insurance certificate), and unregistered contractors cannot get building permits (https://www.lexingtonky.gov/departments/building-inspection; https://www.lexingtonky.gov/working/bids-quotes-rfps/how-register-contractor). Ask CIH for its Lexington registration number before work in Fayette County.

license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Found one record: Schiller Hardware Inc, General Contractor, registration no. 17703, base city Lexington KY. The record was issued 03/06/2017 and expired 12/31/2017. The page shows the status field as 'Issued', but the expiration date is 12/31/2017, and no current-year registration was found under 'Schiller' or 'Schiller Hardware'. Treat it as lapsed unless the company shows a current registration. Lexington registration renews every calendar year.
